RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Aid pulse
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Heal yourself or a visible colonist within 12 cells for 18 base health and grant 25 base shield for 6 seconds. Base cooldown: 8 seconds. Autocast prioritizes the most injured target and avoids full-health targets.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Suppression pulse
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Strike a visible enemy within 12 cells for 10 base physical damage and attempt a 1.5-second stun. Base cooldown: 8 seconds. Boss control resistance and stagger still apply.
